title: Shaping the Prior: How Synthetic Task Distributions Determine Tabular Foundation Model Quality
abstract: arXiv:2605.18971v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: What determines the quality of a tabular foundation model? Unlike language or vision, tabular foundation models acquire their inductive biases almost entirely from synthetic pretraining distributions, yet the design of these distributions remains poorly understood. Standard synthetic priors are too well-behaved: they omit the irregularities and failure modes that determine deployment robustness. We introduce O'Prior, a compositional realism prior built around four coupled components: a hierarchical SCM meta-generator spanning diverse functional families; a modular realism engine covering heterogeneous marginals, missingness, and target transforms; an explicit stress module injecting confounding and support-query mismatch; and a curriculum-governed, leakage-safe generation protocol. translated_title: 塑造先验：合成任务分布如何决定表格基础模型的质量
translated_abstract: 是什么决定了表格基础模型的质量？与语言或视觉领域不同，表格基础模型的归纳偏置几乎完全来自合成预训练分布，但人们对这些分布的设计仍然知之甚少。标准的合成先验过于“良态”：它们忽略了决定部署鲁棒性的不规则性与失效模式。我们提出O'Prior——一个组合式真实感先验，由四个相互耦合的组件构建：一个覆盖多样函数族的分层SCM元生成器；一个涵盖异质边缘分布、缺失机制与目标变换的模块化真实感引擎；一个显式注入混杂因素与支持集-查询失配的压力模块；以及一个由课程机制管控、防泄漏的生成协议。为了将先验设计隔离为唯一的科学变量，我们在固定架构、优化器和计算预算的前提下，仅改变合成任务分布……
tldr: 提出O'Prior组合式真实感合成先验（包含分层SCM元生成器、真实感引擎、压力注入模块与防泄漏课程生成协议），在固定架构与算力的条件下证明合成任务分布的设计是决定表格基础模型质量的关键因素。
en_tdlr: O'Prior, a compositional realism prior combining hierarchical SCM meta-generation, a realism engine, stress injection, and a leakage-safe curriculum protocol, demonstrates that the design of synthetic task distributions—rather than architecture or compute—determines the quality of tabular foundation models.
